########################################
#
# Script contains pairwise comparison of TCR V-identity to compare 
# public results generated by SPTCR and the corresponding raw datasets
# reprocessed by LongAIRR (ONT_R9_original vs ONT_R9_longAIRR)
#
# Additional datasets (S3_ONT_Q17; Visium V1) vs (S4_ONT_Q17_HD; Visium HD 3') are 
# included to compare the older ONT R9 datasets to output from the newer ONT R10
# chemistry
#
# Differences in TCR V-identity distribution between is quantified by Cliff's delta
#
# Results are shown in LongAIRR Fig. 4h
#
########################################


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(effsize)
library(tibble)
#library(chartr)
```

--------------------4_H-------------------
-----TCR V-identity comparison for SPTCR and LongAIRR
------------------------------------------

```{r}
ont_r9_longairr <- file.path("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/1_samples_longairr/1_longairr_revision/af5_samples/public_srr49/public_17_af5_005/airr/", "tr_p_parse-select.tsv")
s3_ont_q17 <- file.path("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/1_samples_longairr/1_longairr_revision/af5_samples/sp8_sd17_af5/airr/", "tr_p_parse-select.tsv")
ont_r9_original <- file.path("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/immcantation_analysis/6_results/heiland/SRR_49/", "GSM7658223_UKF275_SPTCR16_CORRECTED_UMI_CORRRECTED_IGB_TRABDG.csv")
s4_ont_q17_hd <- file.path("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/1_samples_longairr/1_longairr_revision/af5_samples/sp21_hd_sd17_af5/post_whitelist_run/airr/", "tr_p_parse-select.tsv")
```

```{r}
# sptcr ont r9
ont_r9_original_df <- read.csv(ont_r9_original) %>%
  transmute(
    dataset = "ONT_R9_original",
    locus = toupper(Locus), #char into char-vector
    v_identity = parse_number(as.character(v_identity)))

# longairr ont r9
ont_r9_longairr_df <- read.table(ont_r9_longairr, header = TRUE, sep = "\t") %>%
  transmute(
    dataset = "ONT_R9_longAIRR",              
    locus = toupper(locus),
    v_identity = parse_number(as.character(v_identity))) %>%
  mutate(v_identity = ifelse(v_identity <= 1, v_identity * 100, v_identity))

# longairr ont r10
s3_ont_q17_df <- read.table(s3_ont_q17, header = TRUE, sep = "\t") %>%
  transmute(
    dataset = "S3_ONT_Q17",              
    locus = toupper(locus),
    v_identity = readr::parse_number(as.character(v_identity))) %>%
  mutate(v_identity = ifelse(v_identity <= 1, v_identity * 100, v_identity))

# longairr ont r10 visium hd 3'
s4_ont_q17_hd_df <- read.table(s4_ont_q17_hd, header = TRUE, sep = "\t") %>%
  transmute(
    dataset = "S4_ONT_Q17_HD",         
    locus = toupper(locus),
    v_identity = readr::parse_number(as.character(v_identity))) %>%
  mutate(v_identity = ifelse(v_identity <= 1, v_identity * 100, v_identity))

```

```{r}
violin_df <- bind_rows(ont_r9_original_df, ont_r9_longairr_df, s3_ont_q17_df, s4_ont_q17_hd_df) %>%
                       filter(!is.na(v_identity))

violin_df$dataset <- factor(violin_df$dataset, levels=c("ONT_R9_original", "ONT_R9_longAIRR", "S3_ONT_Q17", "S4_ONT_Q17_HD"))

df_plot <- violin_df %>%
  filter(locus %in% c("TRA", "TRB")) %>%
  filter(is.finite(v_identity))
```


```{r}
# comparison groups g1 vs g2
comp_tbl <- tibble(
  group1 = c("ONT_R9_original", "ONT_R9_longAIRR", "ONT_R9_longAIRR", "ONT_R9_original", "ONT_R9_original"),
  group2 = c("ONT_R9_longAIRR", "S3_ONT_Q17",      "S4_ONT_Q17_HD",      "S3_ONT_Q17",      "S4_ONT_Q17_HD"),
  y      = c(103, 113, 123, 133, 143)) # y-anchor to include cliffs value in the figure
```


```{r}
# cliff delta helper using 'effsize' package
cliffs_delta_effsize <- function(x, y) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  y <- y[is.finite(y)]
  stopifnot(length(x) > 0, length(y) > 0)
  res <- effsize::cliff.delta(x, y)
  as.numeric(res$estimate)
}

# compute cliff delta per locus and comparison (g1 vs g2)
delta_brackets <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(locus) %>%
  do({dat <- .
      comp_tbl %>% # compute eff delta on groups
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(delta = cliffs_delta_effsize(x = dat$v_identity[dat$dataset == group1], y = dat$v_identity[dat$dataset == group2]),
             label = paste0("\u03b4 = ", sprintf("%.2f", delta))) %>%
      ungroup()
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(xmin = match(group1, levels(df_plot$dataset)),
         xmax = match(group2, levels(df_plot$dataset)),
         xmid = (xmin + xmax) / 2)
```

```{r}
p_delta_effsize <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = dataset, y = v_identity, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.25, scale = "width", width = 0.8) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.35, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ locus, nrow = 1) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(30, 148)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(30, 100, by = 10), labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("ONT_R9_original" = "gray30", "ONT_R9_longairr" = "gray80", "S3_ONT_Q17" = "black", "S4_ONT_Q17_HD" = "gray60")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "TCR V identity (%)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, angle = 35, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey88"),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray92", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  ) +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual( # adds brackets
    delta_brackets %>%
      transmute(locus, group1, group2, y.position = y, label = ""),
    label = "label", y.position = "y.position", xmin = "group1", xmax = "group2", tip.length = 0.015, bracket.size = 0.25) +
  geom_text(data = delta_brackets, aes(x = xmid, y = y + 3.8, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.5, color = "black")
```

```{r, fig.height=2, fig.width=2.2}
p4_h <- p_delta_effsize + patchwork::plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))) 
p4_h
```

save_dir <- file.path("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel4/intermediates/")
saveRDS(p4_h, file=file.path(save_dir, "p4_h.rds"))
